subject: english
question:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Michael Jackson is known as the King of Pop. He _______ his own genre of music, Pop. His music is spreading its influence and popularity _______ the world.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dominates; around**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**dominates**" appropriately describes Michael Jackson's strong influence and control over the music genre of Pop.
 
• The preposition "**around**" fits well to convey global reach and influence, aligning with the phrase "around the world."
 
• Other options such as "command; besides", "controls; beside", and "presides; round" are grammatically or contextually awkward in this sentence.
 
• Hence, "dominates" and "around" together convey both authority and worldwide popularity effectively.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Michael Jackson is known as the King of Pop. He **dominates**__ his own genre of music, Pop. His music is spreading its influence and popularity __**around**__ the world.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Dominates**: Means to have a commanding influence over (प्रभुत्व जमाना).
 
• **Around the world**: A standard phrase to indicate global presence or reach.
 
• Incorrect pairings like "beside" and "besides" don’t fit spatial or comparative contexts in this sentence.
